analyst_view.overall: Rayo (14th, 12 pts) host Valencia (19th, 9 pts) at Vallecas on Saturday afternoon, a game Valencia badly need. Danjuma has trained fully again and travels, though Aguirre suggests only some minutes off the bench; Otorbi, whom the numbers count as out, travels and may make the squad, while Gayà (banned), Jesús Vázquez, Diego López and Canós are out, so Maffeo or Arnau will play out of position at left-back. Rayo miss Batalla, Luiz Felipe and Óscar Valentín (in the numbers), with Álvaro García and Vertrouwd doubts. Aguirre talks of taking no unnecessary risks and bringing a good result from Madrid. EFE's preview names José Luis Munuera Montero as referee; he has shown the fewest yellows per game in La Liga this season (3.0 in six games), and the numbers have no referee for this match.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.2 goals and already take off for Otorbi and add for Gayà's ban. My earlier trim rested on Danjuma being a doubt, but he trained fully on Friday and travels, likely for minutes off the bench, and Otorbi may even be back in the squad; Aguirre's cautious words point the other way, so I go back to 2.2.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.1 corners and already add some for Valencia conceding plenty lately (39 in six games). Valencia's makeshift left-back could let Ratiu and De Frutos reach the byline, but Álvaro García's doubt may cost Rayo some width on the other side, so I keep 10.1.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.1 cards, with about 12% already added for Valencia's heavy recent card count, but they don't know the referee. One report (EFE) names Munuera Montero, who has shown 3.0 yellows a game this season, the fewest of any La Liga referee; it is only six games and a tense relegation fight, so I trim moderately, to about 4.8.

shots.text: The numbers say 29.0 shots and already add about 22% to Rayo for their heavy shooting against a Valencia side that concedes many attempts; Aguirre himself notes Rayo are second in Spain for entries into the box. Danjuma's return and Álvaro García's doubt roughly cancel, so I keep 29.0.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.4 shots on target, with Rayo's count already raised by their recent form. Sadiq is fit and counted, and Danjuma is likely to play only a part, so nothing new changes Valencia's threat; I stay at 8.4.
